name: metadata-select
description: Select, never write: pick a page's title or description from candidates code found on the captured page, or answer none (#127).

fields.page: { path, h1, headings: [text], first_paragraph, og_title, og_description, site_name }
fields.candidates: array of candidate strings found on the page, in document order

instructions.question: Which of `candidates` is the best value for the page's `field`?

rules.title: Names this page, not the site or a section; 30 to 60 characters; the h1 wins when it is specific.
rules.description: One or two sentences that summarise this page for a search result; 120 to 160 characters; not a navigation label, not boilerplate shared by every page.

instructions.focus: Copy an existing candidate; never prefer a candidate because it is short if it does not describe this page.

appendNone.none: None of the candidates is a suitable value for this field.

boilerplate_risk.instructions: Would the best candidate for `field` be identical on most pages of this site (a site-wide slogan, a footer sentence, a cookie notice)?
